explanation.summary: On 15 July 2020, the compressor showed a sustained pressure drop and a low-pressure alarm, consistent with a reported air leak.

findings.statement: Reservoirs pressure fell as low as 6.284 bar between 16:55 and 18:45, while the normal over the previous 24 h was about 9.05 bar.
TP3 pneumatic panel pressure fell as low as 6.286 bar during the same period, also below the normal ~9.05 bar.
The low-pressure alarm reached 100% for most of the window, with the first reading at 94.4% and a peak of 100%.

possible_causes.cause: An air leak in the pneumatic system, as reported in the maintenance note.
A faulty pressure relief valve or seal allowing pressure to escape.
A failing compressor component reducing pressure output.

recommended_checks.action: Inspect air lines, fittings, valves, and seals for leaks; perform a leak test.
recommended_checks.reason: Air leak reported and pressure drop observed (general guidance).

recommended_checks.action: Verify pressure recovery after the reported maintenance window.
recommended_checks.reason: Maintenance was performed on 16 July; check if pressures returned to normal.

recommended_checks.action: Check the low-pressure alarm system for proper calibration and operation.
recommended_checks.reason: Alarm triggered at 100% during the pressure drop.

missing_information: No readings after the maintenance on 16 July to confirm pressure recovery.
No specific leak location or component identified in the evidence.
explanation.uncertainty: The exact cause of the pressure drop is not confirmed; the air leak is reported but not directly measured.

provenance.hardware_label: AMD GPUs - AMD Token Factory (Radeon Cloud)
